text: Nahagliiv (Dragon Language: Nah–Ag–Liiv, "Fury–Burn–Wither") was a dragon who served Alduin, the World-Eater. He can appear as any variation of dragon, as he is level-based. After he was slain, he was buried in a mound on a hill overlooking Rorikstead.

Customization in Battlefield 6 allows players to modify soldier, weapon, and vehicle loadouts. Four classes are available to modify and switch between, with three loadouts within. Each loadout contains a slot for a primary and secondary weapon, two gadgets, a throwable, and a melee weapon. Each weapon features a litany of attachment slots dependent on the weapon, with a maximum of 100 points per weapon. Players may also customize the attributes and weapons of certain vehicles. Outside of gameplay, players may customize their Player Card Backgrounds, Icons, Titles, Badges and dog tag for display during gameplay. The appearance of soldiers, weapons, and vehicles may be changed with cosmetics. Weapons feature camouflages, weapon packages, stickers and charms while vehicles feature camouflages, skins, and decals. Cosmetics are unlocked by leveling up, completing Mastery Ranks, Twitch Drops, assignments, purchasing through the store, and special events.
Nalur Indrano is a Dunmer Battlemage, and slaver who resides in the cave of Kudanat.
Naeruuna is a ghost Altmer magus residing on the island of Eyevea.

Nairume is an Altmer trapped in ice-form at Falinesti Winter Site. In life, she was living in the walking-city of Falinesti. She was the love interest of an enigmatic Khajiit. After he failed to get her attention, he casted a spell on her, encasing her and ice and she was left behind when the city disappeared.
The Battlefield Vietnam Original Soundtrack consists of eighteen Vietnam era songs heard throughout Battlefield Vietnam, either as menu music or from vehicle Radios.
Nandor Beraid was a fighter of renowned prowess and power elected by the Elder Council to try the armor of Hazadir and be his champion.

Nazubesh is an Orsimer alchemist residing in Stonetooth Fortress, Betnikh. She has a stall called Liquid Courage in the Stonetooth Market where she sells her items. She says she started out as a brewer and that it worked fine for a while, but when her beer started turning people into mudcrabs, she figured it was time for a change.

Nienolas Ulwarth, also known as Nienolas Ulwarth the Mighty, was an Argonian hailing from Blackrose. He was a great Axe-warrior, and is said to be the only person with a greater proficiency at this weapon than Ellabeth, the "Queen of the Axe." However, Nienolas stated that he loved more "his ax handle and shaft," for there was another woman that he loved, Lorinthyrae. As revenge, Ellabeth then captured Nienolas, and gave Lorinthyrae three doors to which she had to open one of three doors. She was told that behind one of the doors was her love, behind another, a great demon, and behind the third, freedom. However, Nienolas was already deceased, as Ellabeth had already killed him.

The Type 97 "Chi-Ha" (Japanese: 九七式中戦車 チハ Kyunana-shiki chu-sensha chiha) was a medium tank used by the Imperial Japanese Army during World War II. It was the most widely produced Japanese medium tank of the period, but with thin armor, relatively small main armament and underpowered engine, it was less effective than most Allied tank designs such as the M4 Sherman.
Nomeg Hyril is a frost atronach that can be found at Nilata Falls in Bangkorai.

Nulfaga, called the Mad Witch, was a Dowager Queen of Daggerfall. Nulfaga was the grandmother of the current King of Daggerfall and is married to Arslan II. She was a powerful mystic and necromancer. She had a dragon familiar named Skakmat.
Nusana is a Dunmer werewolf. She is encountered as part of a boss trio in the Blessed Crucible.

The Black Eagle, also referred to as the Object 640, was a prototype main battle tank developed by Omsktransmash and later Uralvagonzavod for the Russian Federation to replace the aging T-80 and T-72 main battle tanks. Very little information was ever released on either the prototype tanks or their equipment, features, or design. A production version of this tank has never been publicly demonstrated. In May 2010, the project was cancelled by the Russian government, and stated that none of the tanks would be bought, as the tank design was already obsolete. __TOC__

Nuralanya is an Ayleid spirit encountered in the ruins of Salas En. In her time, she had a taboo relationship with an Orc named Gurlak which resulted in her being casted out. After the latter is freed from his long-lasting imprisonment, she returns to greet him once more.

Nurarion the Perfect, also known as Nurarion the Voiceless, was a Merethic Era Altmer hero and member of Khunzar-ri's kra'jun – his company of heroes – who fought against the dragons of Elsweyr. Prior to his adventures in Elsweyr, he fought against the magic of the Maormer king Orgnum in Sunhold, and was the brother of Sunhold's king. Nurarion was said to have wielded the "Subtle Blade."

Ocato, also known as High Chancellor Ocato and later Potentate Ocato, was an Altmer who served as the Imperial Battlemage of Emperor Uriel Septim VII, and the High Chancellor of the Elder Council. After the Oblivion Crisis, he also served as Potentate of the Empire. He was assassinated in or around 4E 14.

The Cavalry Assault Vehicle (CAV) is a light military vehicle. It has a heavy pintle mount with a .51-caliber KORD or .50-caliber XM312 mounted on the front passenger side and an XM307 mounted facing the rear arc.

Olaf One-Eye is a named Draugr found in the crypt of Dead Men's Respite. In life, he was a Jarl of Whiterun who rose to power as a High King of Skyrim during the First Era (reigned in 1E 420 – 1E 452) after defeating the dragon Numinex atop Mount Anthor. He is also the primary antagonist of the Bards College story line. During the Burning of King Olaf festival, Olaf is depicted as a tyrant, and an effigy of him is burned. During the quest "Tending the Flames," a book called King Olaf's Verse must be obtained, before the Bards College can open classes to the Dragonborn. One of the choices for rewriting the Verse includes changing the character of Olaf into Numinex.
Old Strongclaw is a powerful Sabre Cat found in the Crimson Cove.
Onsi, also known as Boneshaver, is a warrior god of the Yokudan Ra Gada. It is said that Onsi taught mankind how to elongate their blades, turning their knives into swords.

The CAR-15 (Colt Automatic Rifle-15 Military Weapons System) is a family of AR-15 and M16-based firearms developed by Colt in the late 1960s and early 1970s, designed to be compact, lightweight versions of the larger AR-15 rifles. The more famous M4 carbine is a successor to the CAR-15's role.

Pahtrok of the Frozen Winds is a powerful Xivkyn found in the Irrigation Tunnels beneath the Imperial City. She can be found patrolling the sewers or in the Barathrum Centrata after the central portal is closed.

Pariel is a Bosmer member of the Falinesti Faithful. She and some of her companions were captured when Wood Orcs of the Lhurgash Clan invaded the Falinesti Spring Site. As a last ditch effort to free herself and her friends, she shapeshifted into a bear, thus breaking the Green Pact and her vows to Y'ffre.

Peryite (Daedric script: ) is the Daedric Prince of pestilence and plague. Among mortals, he is considered the most affable of the Princes and among those with the worst reputations. Among the Daedra, he is charged with ordering the lower planes of Oblivion. Despite his dragon-like appearance, he is generally considered one of the weakest of the Daedric Princes.

The Civilian Car is a vehicle that appears in Battlefield 2: Special Forces and Battlefield 2: Modern Combat. Both games use different models, with the Special Forces car based upon a Range Rover Classic and the Modern Combat version based somewhat upon the third generation Chevrolet Camaro.
Pelagius' Frost Thrall is a unique frost atronach appearing in the "Pelagius' Paranoia" section in Pelagius the Mad's mind during the quest "The Mind of Madness."
The Pilgrim Ghost is a ghost that can be found in Loth'Na Caverns in .
Prelate Athring is a Snow Elf ghost who can be found at the Wayshrine of Sight in the Forgotten Vale.

The is a British light machine gun designed during the 1930s and adopted by the British Army and other Commonwealth forces in 1938, and used extensively during World War II. The Bren was based off the , and had many similar characteristics, such as the top-mounted magazine and feed systems. During World War II, it was chambered in , the same as Lee-Enfield rifles, placed in a typically curved 30-round box magazine. It fired at a rate of fire of around 500 rounds per minute, with an effective range of around 550 meters.
Prelate Edhelbor is a Snow Elf ghost who can be found at the Wayshrine of Radiance in the Forgotten Vale.

Praxin Douare is a Breton member of the Fighters Guild in . He is one of the few sane members of the expedition that went into Spindleclutch I in Glenumbra. In Spindleclutch II, he is encountered again, although this time he has turned into an hostile wraith.
Portal Master Astirhil is an Altmer member of the College of Sapiarchs in . She is in charge of maintaining the portal connecting the college to the city of Lillandril.

The was an Italian machine gun designed by Breda Meccanica Bresciana in 1930. It was in service with the Royal Italian army until 1945. It fired the 6.5x52mm Mannlicher-Carcano cartridge from an attached box magazine that fitted 20 rounds from stripper clips at a rate of around 500 rounds per minute. It had an effective range of 800 meters and a maximum range that reached up to 3000 meters.
Princess Mira is a Breton spirit and the daughter of King Aphren. She is found lingering in his tomb.

Pyre Keeper Rugdrulz is the group boss in Old Orsinium, found in the forge area deep inside. He leaps down from the center platform and attacks after the other Malacath cultists have been defeated. He uses Dragonknight abilities in battle, such as Fiery Breath and Dragon Leap. The fire grates around the arena deals damage as well.

The Purified Warden is a generic Imperial sun mage located in the Depths of Malatar, Gold Coast, in . The Warden wields a greatsword and wears heavy armor, both in the Imperial Style. Like all other Purified, they use the Meridian Purified skin.

The FV4034 "Challenger 2" is a British main battle tank. It is argued to be one of the best protected tanks in the world, and the most durable fighting vehicle actively deployed by NATO forces. __TOC__
Rakel is a Nord werewolf and a member of the Frostmoon Pack. She can be found under Frostmoon Crag with the rest of the pack.
Ragjar is a Nord ghost found in The Foundry of Woe. He was responsible for the death of Gjalder, Lyris Titanborn's father. He transforms into the Manifestation of Regret at half health.

Rajhin's Shadow is the ghostly avatar of the Khajiit trickster-god Rajhin. He appears throughout Northern Elsweyr, Grahtwood and Reaper's March and will challenge the Vestige with finding all the missing pieces of the Rithana-di-Renada mural.

The CM3-N Radar Grenade is a fictional weapon featured in Battlefield 2142. The CM3-N Radar Grenade is an updated version of the SG-34 Smoke Grenade. By using parts from the IDS-1 'Infantry Sonar' it was possible to add a short-range radar sweep to the grenade.
Qukikh is a Banekin found as a random encounter in . He can be seen leaving and entering an Oblivion gate created by him, accompanying his master, Fothxura.
Raynilie Andromo is a Dunmer battlemage and a member of a bandit gang that has occupied the Dunmer stronghold Andasreth. He can be found on the upper level and is hostile.
Raphalas Eul was a fighter of renowned prowess and power elected by the Elder Council to try the armor of Sirollus Saccus.

The Commander's Independent Thermal Viewer (CITV) is equipped on the M1A2 Abrams and provides the tank commander with remote-controlled day and night optics; it is not dissimilar to the periscope used in older designs, as it provides protected, 360-degree view for the commander without having to reorient the tank turret. However, the CITV can also function as a backup main gun sight, and has a 2.6x or 7.7x zoom.

Reman Cyrodiil, also known as Reman I, the Cyrodiil, the Worldly God, Reman Born-a-Man, and Old Reman, was the legendary founder of the Second Empire, the second Cyrodilic and one of the biggest Empires to cover Tamriel. His dynasty lasted for two hundred years, and in that span it annexed all the kingdoms of Tamriel, save for Morrowind. He is known to have conquered Valenwood and the Summerset Isles during his lifetime.
Relie Jeannie is a Breton healer residing in Sanni. They are a member of House Telvanni.

The Restless Draugr is a stronger form of Draugr. Some employ the Frostbite spell in one hand, with a one-handed weapon, usually an Ancient Nord Sword, in the other. Draugr inhabit Nordic Tombs, typically feigning sleep. Coming in close proximity of them causes them to stir and engage in battle. Draugr are also known to summon familiars and use the Voice.

A Chain Gun is a type of machine gun or autocannon that uses an external source of power, rather than diverting energy from the cartridge, to cycle the weapon, and does so via a continuous loop of chain similar to that used on a motor or bicycle.

Reymon Ebonarm, also known as the Black Knight or simply Ebonarm, is a God of War, companion and protector of all warriors. He is the enemy of all Daedric Princes, except for Sheogorath. He can call upon a gold stallion named War Master.

Ria Silmane was one of the few known Imperial Battlemages of the Elder Council, and a former apprentice to ex-Imperial Battlemage Jagar Tharn. Appointed to the Council following Tharn's resignation, Ria is the deuteragonist in the events of . Murdered by her former master in 3E 389, Ria's assumed death and the kidnapping of Emperor Uriel Septim VII marked the beginning of the Imperial Simulacrum. As a spirit, Ria was the guiding figure of the Eternal Champion, divining all locations of the eight pieces of the Staff of Chaos. She preserved her spirit form for nearly ten years as an exceptionally talented sorceress. She finally passed in 3E 399, by using the last remainder of her magic to help the Champion infiltrate the Imperial Palace.

Rynandor was an Altmer who was considered to be a "great seer-mage." The Thalmor ruined his reputation, and forced him to become an exile and later assassinated him when he tried to flee to Anvil. He was one of the few that survived the collapse of Crystal Tower, and his heroic deeds saved many Altmer during the Oblivion Crisis. Lathenil of Sunhold later followed in his footsteps.

A Close-in Barrel is a weapon attachment in Battlefield Play4Free. It increases the short range segment by 10 meters making for assault rifles, LMGs and SMGs and medium range by 5 meters. Sniper rifles get an additional 5 meters (15 meter increase in total) to close range and 7 meters increase to medium range.
.]] Rustjaw is a powerful Troll found in the Root Sunder Ruins.

Rulantaril Oran is a Dunmer mage found in the Crow's Wood. He became trapped there by the Crow Mother after making a pact with her to gain access to a powerful source of magic. Rulantaril is also the father of Telbaril Oran. He chafes against the restrictions of the Mages Guild on certain forms of magic which led him to seek the powers hidden in the realms of Oblivion. He is believed to have a connection to Nocturnal.

Sakeepa is an Argonian herder residing in his home in the settlement of Aleswell. He, like the rest of the town, has been turned invisible by a spell cast by Ancotar. He has a dog, named Sakeepa's Dog.

Casket Mags is a weapon attachment featured in Battlefield Play4Free and is the third and final option for carrying extra ammunition. This option drastically increases the capacity, or Bullet Per Round (BPR), of magazines but not the amount of them carried.
Sahloknir (Dragon Language: Sah–Lok–Nir, "Phantom––Hunt") is a unique named dragon and a supporting antagonist in . He appears at the Kynesgrove dragon burial mound.
Salazar the Wolf is a Breton werewolf. He is part of the trio of bosses found at The Wolf's Camp.
Saint Felms the Bold is a creature that appears in . It is the Dunmer saint Felms, made immortal and given a mechanical body by Sotha Sil.

The C-47 Skytrain or Dakota is a military transport aircraft that was developed from the Douglas DC-3 airliner. It was used extensively by the allies during World War II and remained in front line operations through the 1950s with a few remaining in operation to this day. It was later used for the basis of the AC-47 Spooky ground support gunship, which would later on be succeeded by the AC-130 Gunship.

Sanguine (Daedric script: ), also known as the Lord of Revelry, Blood-Made-Pleasure, Prince of Hedonism, Daedric Lord of Debauchery, Lord of Hard-Partying, the Daedra Prince of Lust, Perversity and Unnatural Sexual Relations and he who tastes the Shaven Fruit, is the Daedric Prince of revelry and debauchery. He also has domain over the darker natures of man, such as lust, sin, sloth, gluttony, and greed. He is the patron deity of sinners and is often seen with a bottle of wine or beer (ale) in his hand. Sanguine enjoys playing pranks on others, one such example being a spell that removes the clothing of everyone within the spell's radius. Although a joker, Sanguine prefers to drag mortals down to sinful lifestyles by means of temptation and humiliation. In Khajiit religion he is known as Sangiin, the Blood Cat, who is known to test the Khajiit with promises of immortality and debaucheries of the flesh. He has over a thousand personal realms known as Myriad Realms of Revelry.
Sarvur Sadri is a Dunmer Battlemage living in Assarnud. He will be hostile towards Nerevarine on sight.

.]] Senche-Tigers are a form of Khajiit, and the largest great cats in existence. Described as monstrous cats, the senche-tiger stands as high as a large horse at the shoulder. Their forelimbs are as thick as columns and half again as long as their rears, giving them an apelike appearance. Senche-tiger coats are tawny, ribboned with stripes the color of dried blood, and their feral yellow eyes seem to promise evisceration. These massive beasts are as smart as any other Khajiit, and can often be found serving as steeds for their more humanoid cousins.
Cerberus Stock is a weapon attachment featured in Battlefield Play4Free.
Sedating Scrib is a Kwama Scrib that accompanies and supports the Transmuted Hive Lord in .

Serana is a Nord and an ancient, pure-blood vampire. She is the daughter of Lord Harkon and Valerica. Serana is known as one of the "Daughters of Coldharbour," and because of this, is central to the main questline in . After being encountered, she can be recruited as a follower, unlocking a multitude of interactions.
The Shade of Ulthorn is a spectral wolf located in Wilding Run, Malabal Tor, in . He is the shade of the person Ulthorn was before he became The Hound.

The [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CZ_805_BREN CZ 805 BREN] is a Czech assault rifle with a modular, multi-caliber design, with an aluminum alloy upper receiver and polymer lower receiver / fire control unit. The magazine housing is a separate detachable unit, which can be replaced in the field as part of a caliber change. The weapon is gas-operated and features a rotating bolt and a manual gas regulator. The weapon features quick-change barrels, allowing users to change calibers and barrel lengths according to the mission profile.

Sheogorath (in Daedric script, ), also known as the King of Madness, Lord of the Never-There, the Mad God, the Mad One, and "Gentleman With a Cane", is the Daedric Prince of Madness. Sheogorath is attended by his Chamberlain Haskill and the Nobles of his realm, the Duke and Duchess of Mania and Dementia. He is also the main antagonist in the Mages Guild questline in .

Arch-Mage Shalidor, sometimes referred to as Archmagus Shalidor, was a famous Nord Archmage and powerful wizard who lived during the First Era. He created the Labyrinthian in Skyrim, the mage sanctuary of Eyevea, and his personal compound of the Fortress of Ice, near Winterhold. Shalidor was said to have a vast knowledge of the workings of Magicka that few could ever compare to.

Shazah is a Khajiit and the sister of Khali. They are both the current Lunar Champions, the two next in line to possibly become the next Mane following Akkhuz-ri's demise. Compared to her sister, Shazah is more reserved and studious, preferring the arts of magic instead of swordplay. She was deeply scarred in her youth by the death of her parents, Namu and Ubraz. During her journey down the Moonlit Path, she learns to accept these terrible events rather than fearing them. In the end, if Khali is chosen as the next Mane, Shazah will be corrupted by the Dark Mane and will need to be put down.

The is a Chinese bolt-action sniper rifle designed & manufactured by . It fires the cartridge instead of the more traditional Chinese round. The , or FY-JS as known in Battlefield 4, is a variant of the CS/LR4 that is chambered to use the lighter 5.8×42mm cartridge. This variant is designated the QBU-141 by the People's Liberation Army.
Shayaifa is a Dark Seducer posing as a friendly Redguard in . She is found at The Manor of Revelry in Coldharbour.

A Sheartooth is a kind of fish living in Umbriel's sump. Sheartooths have a maw full of teeth. The teeth are even bigger than those of a shark. They can be as long as fifteen feet long. Its tail is long, whiplike, and it has two great swimming fins set under it, like a whale. They have an incredible force. A Sheartooth attacked Mere-Glim during his first day at the sump, and it severely wounded Wert. Skraws ate sheartooth steak sometimes.

Shaukadur the Impaler is a giant scorpion in that resides in the Scorpion Ravine alongside three other giant scorpions. In battle, it will occasionally summon more giant scorpions to fight the Vestige.
The CBJ-MS is a submachine gun developed by Swedish company CBJ Tech AB. It is chambered for both 6.5×25mm CBJ-MS and 9×19mm cartridges.

Shezarr, also called the Missing Sibling and the God of Man, is the Cyrodilic interpretation of Lorkhan, who is the creator of Mundus and the creator and hero of Mankind. He is sometimes associated with the founding of the first Cyrodilic battlemages. While initially revered as a deity by both the Imperials and Nords, the melding of Nordic and Aldmeri culture at around 1E 242 during the formation of the Alessian Empire resulted in what can be described as the "spirit behind all human undertaking." Despite obvious similarities to Shor, the Nordic version of Shezarr, this was accepted by the Nords. Even though he is still worshipped in small cults in Cyrodiil, his importance suffered greatly when Akatosh began to be worshipped in the province. He is now mostly forgotten. He is connected with the Shezarrine, a strong figure who may have been Pelinal Whitestrake. Saint Alessia believed that "freedom" was just another name for Shezarr.
Shield Maidens are Nereids found in the Hall of Worship in Shada's Tear. They do not attack, and instead buff their allies in golden light.
Silent Claw is a powerful Senche-Tiger found in the Root Sunder Ruins.
Carrier Assault is a gamemode featured in the Battlefield 4: Naval Strike expansion. It is a re-imagined variant of the Titan game mode from Battlefield 2142.

Sir Casimir was a member of the old Knights of the Nine. Casimir left the order during the War of the Red Diamond, taking the Gauntlets of the Crusader with him. When he returned from the war he was changed, no longer having pity for the weak and helpless. He hoped to return to the services of the Nine and went to the Chapel of Stendarr. While there, a beggar began pestering him daily and soon Casimir let his temper get the best of him. He struck the beggar out of anger and killed him, right in the Chapel of the God of Mercy. He was cursed by Stendarr and the Gauntlets fell off of his hands and became impossible to move. The curse left Casimir tired and weak, a curse that has followed his family to this day.
Sinding is a Nord werewolf imprisoned in the jail of Falkreath.
Siri is a Nord Crusader, and Vampire who resides in the Lower Level of Druscashti, a Dwemer Ruin in the Ashlands of Morrowind. After killing her, Vampire Dust can be harvested.

A Cannon is any piece of artillery that uses gunpowder or another usually explosive-based propellant to launch a projectile. The real-life basis for the in-game cannon are muzzle-loaded European coastal artillery dating back to the Colonial era. These cannon were designed specifically for the purpose of fort defense against naval forces, being mounted directly to the fort superstructure along a swiveling rail system.

Sister Phebe Jeanard is a Breton healer living in Gottlesfont Priory. She shares a house beside the priory with Sister Angrond and they spend the day gathering plants and other ingredients to make potions.
The Skeletal Pyromancer is a creature in . They guard The Wailing Prison. Similarily to the Skeletal Archer, they fire projectiles at the Vestige.
Skalhexx the Cremator is a Xivkyn in . She may be found patrolling the Imperial City Sewers. She primarily uses ranged and AoE attacks.

The McMillan CS5 or the "Concealable Subsonic/Supersonic Suppressed Sniper System" is a bolt action Sniper Rifle. It is designed as a compact and concealable precision tactical rifle in urban settings. It is chambered for the 7.62x51mm NATO cartridge.

Sirran Angada is a mortal sorcerer working at the Battlespire during the Imperial Simulacrum. At the behest of the false Emperor Jagar Tharn, he betrays his fellow Battlemages and opens a portal to the Battlespire to allow Mehrunes Dagon to invade. In order to do this, he uses a spell in order to appear as though he is Lomegan Mariel, the Imperial Secretary. He is later be killed by the Hero of Battlespire. He is furthermore known to be a user of shapeshifting magic.
Skooma Cat is an Alfiq incarnation of Sheogorath found in Northern Elsweyr.
The Skull of Illion is a Bosmer skull located in Driladan Pass, Greenshade, in . Ollion has been cursed with existing in a state between life and death because he violated the Green Pact.

.]] The SRSS (Short Rifle Stock System) Bulldog 762 Gen-4 is a bullpup battle rifle that fires the 7.62x51mm NATO cartridge. The weapon is a rifle conversion/retrofit kit that uses M14 rifle parts and places them in a bullpup stock chassis. It was developed due to the demand for a short selective fire 7.62 caliber rifle for close quarters combat without sacrificing maneuverability with a long barrel and the reduced range of a shortened barrel.

Besting the most well-equipped fighters, Sorcerers rely on the spells of the mystic arts. Unique to these mages is the bodily stamina to be armed with the thickest armor. Sorcerers also possess the unique ability to absorb magicka from spells targeted at them, serving in essence as magical "batteries," and possess more magicka than any other mage class. Sorcerers are adept at the use of a wide variety of weapons and armor, but typically do not utilize shields, preferring to keep their hands free for defensive spellcasting instead, their specialty.
Solea Nuccusius is an Imperial Battlemage serving the Imperial Legion at Moonmoth Legion Fort.
Sosia Caristiana is a Breton Healer who can be found in the West Gash region. She stole Cloudcleaver from the barbarian Hlormar Wine-Sot.

A breaching hammer (or dynamic hammer) is a tool used by military and law enforcement to force open a door which is locked or otherwise not able to be opened. The common sledge hammer can fill the same purpose, and was used by military and police forces before the adoption of purpose-built breaching hammers.
Sorian is a Redguard battemage residing in the Gandrung Caverns.
Soki is a Nord magus who resides in Hissmir, Shadowfen. She is a member of the Mages Guild.
Songbird's Brute is a generic hostile Brute residing in Shipwreck Cove, in Vvardenfell. They are controlled by a Nereid called Kimbrudhil the Songbird.

The sabre or saber is a sword designed for use from horseback. Based on a medieval type of single-edged weapon and European backsword, the saber was adopted as the weapon of heavy cavalry in early modern warfare. Although sabers are typically thought of as curved-bladed slashing weapons, those used by the heavy cavalry of the 17th to 19th centuries often had straight and even double-edged blades more suitable for thrusting. The length of sabers varied, and most were carried in a scabbard hanging from a shoulder belt known as a baldric or from a waist-mounted sword belt, usually with slings of differing lengths to permit the scabbard to hang below the rider's waist level.
Soul of Irthari is a Wraith found in Eidolon's Hollow in Deshaan.

Springheel Jak, a legendary thief, lived and reigned roughly 300 years before the Hero's career in . His name first appears in a mission assignment from the Gray Fox, a supposedly immortal and infamous Guildmaster of the Thieves Guild.
Ssa'ass was an Argonian member of Moraelyn's Companions. He lived at some point during the duration of the First Era, and was a skilled healer.

The Caproni Ca.5 was an Italian bomber biplane used during the latter years of World War I, and the last of its series. It was developed in response to fighter aircraft that were able to defend against earlier models, gaining a new wing and fuselage design, and increasingly powerful engines each providing up to 360 horsepower.

Stendarr, also known as S'rendarr, is the God of Righteous Might and Merciful Forbearance. He is the inspiration of magistrates and rulers, the patron of the Imperial Legions and the comfort of the law-abiding citizen. Stendarr has evolved from his Nordic origins into a deity of compassion or sometimes, righteous rule. He is said to have accompanied Tiber Septim in his later years. In early Altmeri legends, Stendarr is the apologist of Men.
Stephen Callyn is a Breton werewolf found at his camp west of Shornhelm.

Stinger is a giant scorpion in . It is summoned by The Beast Master in the snowy arena of the Blessed Crucible, after the Incineration Beetles are fought. It can create a cloud of poison under a player, dealing heavy damage.

The was an double-action revolver and the main service handgun of the Royal Italian Army from 1891 to 1910. In Italian service, the weapon was chambered in 10.35x22mm, and held six shots in the chamber. It was produced in two distinct variants - a model with an octagonal barrel and a folding trigger, for issue to enlisted men, and another manufactured in smaller numbers for the officers and NCOs, featuring a round barrel and a solid trigger guard. Although the weapon was supplanted by more modern, semi-automatic handguns such as the Beretta M1915 during World War I, the Bodeo was not declared obsolete until the end of World War II. Additionally, the Bodeo was produced for the Spanish Army during The Great War, and utilized in the subsequent conflict by the Wehrmacht.
Sun Shield is a Templar active skill in the Aedric Spear skill line in .

Styriche was the Vampire king of the city-state of Verkarth during the time of the Alessian Empire. The Breton Vampire was the leader of the Gray Host, a dreadful army consisting of bat-men and wolves that purged the land around them.

Sumeer Jabran is a Daedra Lord and the leader of the Dremora in The High Halls and Librarium. He is not hostile, and will task the Apprentice with locating the missing pieces of the voidguide. If they ally with or agree to serve him, he will allow them to teleport to the next level unharmed.
Camouflage is a Codex Entry featured in Battlefield 1. It is unlocked upon killing an enemy Scout with a rifle in the Scout kit.

Symphony of Blades is the final boss of Depths of Malatar. It is the form King Narilmor takes in the final area, having been empowered by his mistress. He summons various Aurorans that march towards him, and will empower his attacks if they reach. He also summons an Auroran Phalanx occasionally that will instantly kill players on contact, even on normal mode. At about 10% health the boss will transport everyone into the Colored Rooms, healing itself as well as sending out smaller but multiple Auroran Phalanxes marching in different paths.

Tadara Indaram is a Dunmer pilgrim in Molag Mar, Morrowind. She can be found at the St. Veloth's Hostel atop the city. Tadara favors the restoration school of magic and knows several healing spells. She is not involved in any quests and does not offer any services.
Tanval Indoril is a Dunmer pyromancer and the grandmaster of House Indoril, by extension its acting commander. He and his son Garyn are heavily involved in the Stonefalls questline.
Body Armor is a Codex Entry featured in Battlefield 1. It is unlocked upon obtaining three headshots.
Taurieae is a powerful Lamia found inside the Serpent's Nest in Craglorn, Hammerfell.

Telacar is an Altmer ghost confined to the Ossuary of Telacar, Grahtwood. He and his wife, Vastarie, were once friends with Mannimarco. Telecar was sealed with his ossuary after Vastarie disproved of him wanting to resurrect their deceased son, Calion, as a Flesh Atronach.
Taskmaster Ninbael is a Dunmer Thundermaul in and one of the leaders of the Pit Rats found in Darkshade Caverns I, Deshaan.

Bourlon Wood is a Codex Entry featured in Battlefield 1. It is unlocked by not allowing the tank to get damaged before clearing the village in the chapter Steel on Steel in the singleplayer mission Through Mud and Blood. A simple way to accomplish this is to avoid the village all together by driving Black Bess along the left border of the map and reach the windmill. Despite the criteria stating the village needs to be cleared, it will still be unlocked without killing any enemies.
Thalin Ebonhand is a hostile ghost found in Gyldenhul Barrow at the conclusion of the quest "Deathbrand".

Tharer Rotheloth is a Dunmer Monk, a Tribunal member, and the master of the Molag Mar Temple. He is extremely quick and agile, which is reflected by the skills in which he trains. Tharer also has several quests available to fellow Tribunal Temple members.

Tharsten Heart-Fang is the Nord leader of the Skaal Village. He is also infected with lycanthropy, and may be encountered at Mortrag Glacier as a werewolf during the fulfillment of the Bloodmoon Prophecy.

A Bomb Sight allows bombardiers to accurately drop bombs on a target, accounting for various factors such as the speed of the aircraft, wind, and altitude. Prior to World War I, dropping bombs was done by trial-and-error. Towards the end of the war, devices such as the Course Setting Bomb Sight could take input from control dials and the plane's instruments, removing a great deal of guesswork. Later systems would also incorporate autopilot, allowing crews to attend to other tasks en route to the target.

The Black Dragon is a mysterious and powerful assassin who serves as the First Sword of the Order of the Hour. Along with Primate Artorius, she is one of the antagonists of the Dark Brotherhood questline, having been killing off their members.
The Flame King is a powerful Nede warrior found in the Skyreach Catacombs. He can summon a ghostly Daedroth to assist him.
The Engine Guardian is an enormous Dwarven Spider boss in and guardian of the Great Engine located deep in Darkshade Caverns II, in the Dwemer city of Rkugamz.

The Breakthrough Package is a Vehicle Package featured in Battlefield 1 for the A7V. It provides a total of four seats, one for the driver and three for the gunners. It provides the driver access to the 57mm Case Cannon and Twin HMGs while gunners have access to HE Autocannons. The driver also has access to the Emergency Repair and Drop Supplies specializations.

The Gray Fox is the guildmaster of the Thieves Guild. He gets his name from his sneakiness in thievery and from the gray mask, the Gray Cowl of Nocturnal, that he wears. The first Gray Fox stole the cowl from the Daedric Prince Nocturnal herself. The title of Gray Fox is passed from leader to successor by giving the Gray Cowl of Nocturnal to the successor. Since the successor then becomes the Gray Fox, many think that he has been alive for over 300 years. In the book Purloined Shadows, a young female thief is enlisted to help a master thief. During a ritual performed by witches, Nocturnal is summoned, and she removes her cowl during the ritual. The young thief is hiding there, waiting for the master's signal to steal the cowl. Suddenly, the master's voice cries out, warning Nocturnal of the young thief's presence. Nocturnal turns and begins to strangle the young thief. The young thief, before she dies, notices that the cowl has disappeared. It is presumed that the master thief then dons the cowl and becomes the Gray Fox, activating the curse of the cowl in the process. It is unknown whether the book is true or not, but it tells possibly the only full story of how the Gray Fox came to be in possession of the cowl. The names of both thieves are never revealed in the book; however, at the end of the Thieves' Guild quest line, the current Gray Fox names Emer Dareloth as the true thief of the cowl.
The Golden Prince is a Breton ghost found in the Burial Mounds in Glenumbra.
The Moonlit Maiden is a powerful Wispmother found in the Crow's Wood.

is the frequently used name for a series of Italian bolt-action, magazine-fed, repeating military rifles and carbines. Introduced in 1891, this rifle was chambered for the rimless cartridge. It was developed by the chief technician at the Turin Army Arsenal in 1890 and called the Modello (model) 91 or simply M91. Successively replacing the previous Vetterli-Vitali rifles and carbines in 10.35×47mmR, it was produced from 1892 to 1945. The M91 was used in both rifle (fucile) and shorter-barreled carbine (moschetto) form by most Italian troops during the First World War and by Italian and some German forces during the Second World War. The Tromboncino M28 ("Little Trombone") is an Italian single-shot muzzle loaded grenade launcher introduced in 1928, designed to be used with the Carcano M91 TS (Truppe Speciali) variant of the Carcano rifle. The M28 is fitted to the right side of the carbine, with the rifle trigger linked up to the it. The M28 uniquely shares its bolt with the base Carcano; to use the launcher, the carbine's bolt must be removed from its receiver and installed in the launcher. The weapon was considered impractical due to its weight, production cost, and the time taken to transition from rifle to grenade launcher, leading to the system being retired by 1934. The Carcano M91 Cavalry Carbine is featured in Battlefield 1, while the Carcano M91 TS Carbine with attached Tromboncino M28 is featured in Battlefield V as the "M28 con Tromboncino" (literally "M28 with Tromb
The Pale Lady is a unique wispmother encountered within Frostmere Crypt, in The Pale.

The Whisperer is a Spider Daedra that appears in . It is instrumental in the quest "Deadly Whispers," and is the final boss of the dungeon Spindleclutch I. It is responsible for turning some Fighters Guild expedition members against each other using a form of mind control.

Thomas is a deceased bandit wizard in that can be found in Bleak Falls Barrow. He carries the Note to Thomas. He was attempting to kill a troll in order to prove himself to his fellow bandits, but evidently slipped and fell to his death within the caves. He wears a set of fur armor and depends on his magical abilities rather than physical weapons.

Coastal-Class Airships were a type of dirigible used during World War I to patrol coastlines, protect naval convoys and perform anti-submarine warfare. The French designed by Spaniard was also purchased by Japan and Britain. The British would copy much of the design to create their own C-Class. Armament varied from Lewis Guns for general protection, the Lee-Enfield rifle (for anti-mine operations), to bombs and depth charges for anti-submarine use.
Thelama Indalas is a Dunmer Battlemage and slaver residing in the stronghold of Hlormaren. She is located on the bottom level of the stronghold's keep.
Thrasotin the Ravenous Flame is a Xivkyn in . She may be found patrolling the Imperial City Sewers. She primarily uses ranged and AoE attacks.

Tolfdir is an Elder Nord mage at the College of Winterhold, where he teaches. An old, wise, and friendly mage, Tolfdir is adept in defensive magic, plus a master of Alteration and a trainer in its use. Some spells he sells include Telekinesis, Waterbreathing and Ebonyflesh. He serves as the Dragonborn's teacher and guide at the college. When Ancano is defeated, Tolfdir becomes Master Wizard of the College, succeeding Mirabelle Ervine following her death at the hands of the Thalmor agent.
The Carcano M91 Carbine is a Codex Entry featured in Battlefield 1, introduced in the Turning Tides expansion. It is unlocked by obtaining 10 kills with the Carcano M91 Carbine.
Thulendor is a Bosmer werewolf found in the town of Tanglehaven. He appears as the boss at the end of the quest "A Father's Promise."

Tilelle the Mender is a Breton residing in Brass Fortress, Clockwork City. When the Vestige first meets her, she is an aspiring Clockwork Apostle found at the Halls of Regulation. Following the quest "The Halls of Regulation," she can be found at the Clockwork Basilica, and reveals she has been accepted into the order, and is known as Initiate Tilelle.
Torkild is a werebear and the brother of Wulf Wild-Blood in .

Pigeon photography, invented in 1907 by Julius Neubronner, is an aerial photography technique that used Carrier Pigeons to capture photos. Pigeons were fitted with an aluminum breast harness that allowed a time-delayed miniature camera to be attached. Pigeon photography was extensively tested by the German military during World War I and while it showed promise, the rapid development of aviation during the war caused the military to lose interest. This was also owed to the challenge of training and handling of the birds to carry the necessary loads and the limited control over the pigeons' position, orientation and speed when the photographs were being taken. While carrier pigeons were also used extensively during World War II, it is unknown to what extent they were used in arial photography. The Central Intelligence Agency is known to have developed battery-powered cameras for espionage pigeon photography through details remain classified. Today some researchers, enthusiasts and artists similarly deploy crittercams with various species of animals for photography.
Trebonius Artorius is an Imperial and the Arch-Mage of the Morrowind Mages Guild.

Tsun is a Nordic hero in who is described as the ancient god of trials against adversity in the Nordic pantheon. He served as shield-thane to Shor and died defending him from foreign gods during the Ehlnofey wars of the Dawn Era. In the ancient Nordic pantheon, he was often depicted as a bear.
Tsavi is a Khajiit mage and healer for Count Marius Caro at Castle Leyawiin.

The Tank, Infantry, Mk IV (A22) Churchill was a British heavy infantry tank used in the Second World War, best known for its heavy armour, large longitudinal chassis with all-around tracks with multiple bogies, its ability to climb steep slopes, and its use as the basis of many specialist vehicles. It was one of the heaviest Allied tanks of World War II.

Tyermaillin is an Altmer healer and member of the Blades. He is currently living in his house, in Balmora with a fellow Blade, Rithleen. The Nerevarine will be sent by Caius Cosades to receive training if they want it. Tyermaillin provides training in Enchant, Mysticism, and Restoration. He also sells potions, spells, and ingredients.
Tunila Omavel is a Dunmer healer who resides in Omavel's House in Tel Uvirith and provides healer services within the House Telvanni.

Tubidan the Alarmist is a Khajiit ghost and a member of the Undaunted. He is found with his spiritual companions at The Shining Star in the Hollow City. The Vestige can buy him a drink as part of This One's On Me achievement.

Choke may refer to: *Full Choke - A weapon attachment featured in Battlefield 4 and Battlefield 1 and as a weapon specialization featured in Battlefield V. *Modified Choke - A weapon attachment featured in Battlefield 4. *Duckbill - A weapon attachment featured in Battlefield 4 and Battlefield 1.

Ubraz is Khajiit spirit encountered during the visions taking place inside the temple in Rawl'kha. In life, he was the father of the two current Lunar Champions Khali and Shazah. He was a healer. He tended to people afflicted by a potent plague that swept through Elsweyr but ended up contracting it himself and perishing in the process.
Ulmiso Maloren is a Dunmer living in the Ghostgate. She is a healer of the Tribunal Temple, and will sell potions and spells, mainly of the Restoration variety.
Ulumpha gra-Sharob is an Orsimer Healer living in Fort Darius Imperial Legion base in Gnisis, Morrowind. She is a member of the Imperial Legion.

Churchill may refer to: *Churchill Mk VII - British Heavy Tank in Battlefield V. *Churchill Gun Carrier - Tank destroyer variant of the Churchill that appears in Battlefield V. *Churchill Crocodile - Flamethrower tank variant of the standard Churchill available as a reinforcement in Battlefield V. *Churchill AVRE - Artillery variant of the Churchill that was cut from Battlefield V.
Ulene Hlervu is a Dunmer Healer who serves as the Court Wizard for Castle Cheydinhal. She can help the Hero locate the Shrine of Azura.
Umbra' Keth, or the Shadow of Conflict, is a special creature and the primary antagonist in .
Uncle Bones is an undead skeleton found at the Pariah Catacombs in Stormhaven.

The (Italian: Presa Gas, Gas Operated) was an Italian magazine-fed automatic rifle that was produced by . Originally developed as a semi-automatic, self-loading rifle for the Italian Army, it was rejected from domestic service. However, it did achieve sales to in 1935; the Costa Rican contract model featured a unique select-fire system including semi-auto and 4-round bursts, making it one of the first rifles to incorporate a burst fire mode. Only a few hundred were ever made.

Ulfnir Bone-Skin is an armored skeleton in and is a part of the Alternative Armors – Dragonscale Creation Club creation. He was an ancient Nord warrior of legend known for having slaying the dragon Vithrelnaak and using his scales to create a set of studded armor. Instead of giving his armor to his ungrateful pupils, he buried his armor before he died.

Urnsi Serethi is a Dunmer living in Aleswell. She is the sister of Diram Serethi, owner and inkeeper of the Aleswell Inn. Like the rest of the citizens in Aleswell, Urnsi was affected by an Invisibility spell casted upon the small town by Ancotar, a sorcerer residing in the nearby Fort Caractacus. Urnsi is not impressed at all about the help the Hero did to release the spell.

Vaermina the Dreamweaver (Daedric script: ), or Vaernima (in Daedric script: ), is one of the sixteen Daedric Princes. The Daedra Lady of Corruption and Decay, her sphere of influence includes nightmares, psychological terror and torment, dreams, evil omens, and stealing memories.

The H&R SPIW is a prototype assault rifle designed for the Special Purpose Individual Weapon program by Harrington & Richardson. The H&R SPIW used a revolving open chamber system designed by David Dardick of Dardick revolver fame. The only reciprocating component in the weapon was a top-mounted gas piston, which cammed a revolving cylinder 120 degrees with each fired shot. The SPIW also features a three-shot, semi-automatic, revolver-style grenade launcher that attaches beneath the barrel of the weapon. The three chambers are loaded from the rear.

Vampire Fledglings are the most basic type of vampiric creatures. They are the weakest of their kind, making them the easiest to contract Sanguinare Vampiris from. One can usually be found wherever there are other vampires.
Vanel Serven is a Dunmer Battlemage who lives in Tel Naga. He is a member of House Telvanni.
Valana the Dreamweaver is a powerful Dunmer mage and a member of the Scaled Court. She is found inside Skyreach Hold.

Charms, or Weapon Charms, are small decorations that are attached to weapons or other equipment to customize the weapon to the user's liking. Charms are normally attached with string, lanyard or a beaded link to a base attached to the body of the weapon, swaying with movement and gravity. All charms are cosmetic in nature, and do not offer an advantage to its user. In the Battlefield series, charms appear as cosmetic items in Battlefield V, Battlefield 2042 and Battlefield 6. In each installment, charms are unlocked through regular progression, Battle Passes, external promotions, and store purchases.
Vahlokzin is a dragon encountered in . He has stolen the Horn of Ja'darri from the Dragonguard in order to protect his fellow dragons from its power.
Valdur is a ghost appearing throughout The Rift. He was one of Ysgramor's Five Hundred Companions, and was entombed in Taarengrav to ward against the return of Sinmur.

Vastarie is an Altmer priestess of Azura found at the Tower of Vastarie in Grahtwood. She can later be found at the Ashen Scar scar in Northern Elsweyr. She was a member of the Psijic Order who was interested in the applications of necromancy. Entering Coldharbour with Mannimarco, she sought the power of souls. Fleeing from Molag Bal, she hid in Valenwood. She then traveled in search of places of power, hoping to answer the questions that gnawed at her soul. She later informed the Mages Guild of her discoveries and was shunned by Vanus Galerion after discovering the power of Sigil Geodes. She uses illusions to conceal her status as a lich. Her husband was Telacar, and her son Calion (also known as the Pale Sentinel). She is perhaps one of the few necromancers, along with Yisareh, who have used their powers for what one might consider good.

The Ordnance QF 25-pdr on Carrier Valentine 25-pdr Mk 1 "Bishop" was a self-propelled artillery vehicle used by the British during World War II. A modification of the Valentine infantry tank, the Bishop replaced the rotating turret with a boxy armored superstructure to mount a single QF 25-pdr howitzer. Around 150 vehicles were built, entering service in 1942.

Vicente Valtieri is a Breton member of the Dark Brotherhood, residing in the Cheydinhal Sanctuary. He became a vampire on an expedition to Morrowind and has been a member of the Dark Brotherhood for over two hundred years.

Vighar is an Elder Nord master vampire in who rules over the vampires of the Bloodlet Throne, located in the mountains in Falkreath Hold. He is an ancestor of Dengeir of Stuhn, Thadgeir, and Siddgeir, who are residents of Falkreath.
, Vivec, Foreign Quarter Vivec Mages Guild is a location in .

The Churchill AVRE (Assault Vehicle Royal Engineers) was a modification of the Churchill infantry tank used during World War II. Developed in response to the disastrous , the AVRE was one of several in a series nicknamed which were specialised engineering vehicles intended for obstacle clearing during beach landings. The AVRE was equipped with a 290mm spigot mortar dubbed the "Flying Dustbin" which could launch high-explosive charges for destroying barricades, bunkers and minefields. The vehicle saw action during and after .
Vonshala is a powerful Dremora which can be summoned alongside Methats and Sumeer at various Dark Anchors across Tamriel.
Vosis is a Draugr Dragon Priest who can be found in Forelhost in the region of The Rift.

Vykosa the Ascendant is a Khajiit werewolf in , and is the primary antagonist and final boss of Moon Hunter Keep in Reaper's March. She was the first person to have been given lycanthropy and made a werewolf by Hircine.
The (Armored Modular Vehicle) is a vehicle developed by . The vehicle uses a modular design that can swap/support different turrets, weapons, sensors and communication systems.
War Chief Helushk is Kothringi residing in Stillrise Village. Unlike Shaman Chirah, Helushk sees his undead immortality as the perfect opportunity for him and his men to become great warriors.

A werewolf is someone who has lycanthropy and the ability to turn into a wolf or wolf-like creature. Werewolves were originally created by Hircine. Werewolves are the most common type of lycanthrope and can be found in nearly all areas of Tamriel.

Watchers are floating tentacle-like Daedra. They appear as giant floating eyeballs with multiple tendrils protruding from all sides which they use for melee attacks alongside magical attacks. Watchers are often employed to guard prisons, such as the Imperial City Prison and the Vaults of Madness. In addition to their combat abilities, some are shown to have more subtle and sinister powers. One is used by the forces of Molag Bal to induce fear and doubt in Lyris Titanborn. Several are used by Vaermina to sow paranoia and discord throughout Stormhaven, in hopes of overthrowing High King Emeric and allowing the Supernal Dreamers to take over.
Closed Weapon is a gamemode modifier featured in Battlefield 6 and Battlefield Portal, first shown during the Battlefield 6: Open Beta.

Watcher Garalan is an undead Nede found inside the Skyreach Catacombs. In order to seal Virmaril, who had betrayed his own people, Garalan, Armok and Shavmar sacrificed themselves and became his eternal watchers.

Watcher Shavmar is an undead Nede found inside the Skyreach Catacombs. In order to seal Virmaril, who had betrayed his own people, Shavmar, Armok and Garalan sacrificed themselves and became his eternal watchers.

Werewolf Skinwalker are feral Werewolves encountered in . They can be encountered as random encounters. They will attack the Dragonborn and any followers on sight. If the Dragonborn is alone and in Beast Form, however, the Werewolf Skinwalker will not be hostile.
The Carl-Gustaf is a Swedish made, multi-role, recoilless, 84mm, anti-tank rifle. It was designed in 1964 by Hugo Abramson to fill the role of a squad anti-tank weapon.
Will-o-the-Wisp are glowing, ghost-like creatures that live throughout Cyrodiil.

Wispmothers are creatures found in the frozen, mountainous regions of Skyrim. Wisps can be spotted floating in the wild, and remain neutral. If the wisp is approached, it moves away and eventually leads to a wispmother.

Wisps are small, glowing phantasms found in . They typically appear with Wispmothers, and drain their victims' life energy with their special attack, Wisp's Kiss. Destroying them causes damage to the Wispmother.

A Blowtorch is a tool used to diffuse a flame to apply heat upon an object. It is often used for repairs to a structure or vehicle. Depending on the mixture of fuel and oxygen, the same torch can be used to weld workpieces together, or burn off metal as a cutting operation. It is a gadget featured in many installments of the Battlefield Series, sometimes under the Repair Tool name.
Willow was a Bosmer and a member of Moraelyn's Companions sometime during the First Era. She was the sister of Beech, another Bosmer in this faction. Willow had an innate talent for spell absorption.

Wulfharth or Wulfarth, also known as Ysmir, Dragon of the North, Shor's Tongue, and the Breath of Kyne was an ancient king of Skyrim. He is the subject of several Nordic myths and legends, and has become known as The Underking or The Ash King. Wulfharth was proficient at using the Thu'um, and his voice was so powerful that he could not verbally take the oath of allegiance required of him by the Pact of Chieftains. He is said to have died and been resurrected multiple times throughout Tamrielic history.

The Wyrm of Elynglenn is a legendary serpent that lives in the elven ruins of Elenglynn, located in the Great Forest of Cyrodiil. The Wyrm was defeated by Sir Amiel Lannus and his group of the Knights of the Nine when they retrieved the Cuirass of the Crusader. Sir Amiel's victory over the wyrm led to the early fame of the Knights, ever since their time in the War of the Isle. Afterward, the Knights established their base of operations in the West Weald, the Priory of the Nine.

A Bomber is a military aircraft designed to attack ground and sea targets by dropping bombs on them, firing torpedoes at them, or – in recent years – by launching cruise missiles at them. Bombers typically have considerable endurance in order to carry heavy payloads from an arsenal to targets in hostile territory. However, they must defend against more maneuverable interceptor aircraft and ground anti-aircraft positions, to which their heavier armor affords protection, while mounted guns allow for close-range defense. Other escort aircraft can also engage these threats, allowing the bombers to focus on their primary mission of destroying targets below.
Wyress Rashan is a Redguard member of the Glenmoril Wyrd found in Jackdaw Cove. She can transform into a Wolf Guardian.

Ysmir is the Nordic aspect of Talos. According to the Greybeards, the name "Ysmir" is also a title which means "Dragon of the North." It was given to the Emperor Tiber Septim, who withstood the power of the Greybeards' Thu'um; they recognized him as a Dragonborn and gave him the title.
Yngvild Ghost is a spectral hostile character in . They are found only in Yngvild, and are a result of the Necromancer Arondil's experiments.

Boost may refer to: *Vehicle Boost - The option to drive faster when operating a vehicle in the Battlefield 2, Battlefield 2142, Battlefield 3, Battlefield 4, Battlefield 1 and Battlefield V. *Sarge's Stamina Boost - A Widget featured in Battlefield Heroes that increases the players amount of Health. *XP Multiplier - Score Bonuses featured in Battlefield Heroes, Battlefield Play4Free, Battlefield 3, Battlefield 4, Battlefield Hardline, Battlefield 1 and Battlefield V. *Booster Pack - A purchasable item featured in Battlefield V.
Young Soot-Paw is a powerful Bear found with its mother inside a cave in The Lion's Den.

Zamarak is an exiled Khajiit adept of the Desert Wind martial arts and former Claw of the royal family of Rimmen under King Hemakar and Queen Numara. He joins the Vestige, Abnur Tharn, and Khamira to restore the monarchy and rid Elsweyr of its dragon threat.
Zariya is a Redguard Ghost located in the Tears of the Dishonored, Alik'r Desert, in .
The Cobra is a Turkish four-wheeled light armored vehicle designed by Otokar in the 1990s. It bases some of its design elements off the American HMMWV.
Zibakka is a ghostly Khajiit part of the boss trio encountered at Captain Bones' Ship.
Zulagogg the Enkindler is a Xivkyn in . He may be found patrolling the Imperial City Sewers. He mainly uses ranged and AoE attacks.
Zoal the Ever Wakeful is a Watcher in . It is a Patrolling Horror found in the Elven Gardens District. Uniquely for a Watcher, it uses shock-based attacks.

The Demolition kit is a playable class unique to Battlefield: Bad Company. The class itself serves much the same purpose as Anti-Tank kit from Battlefield 2. However, it is not exactly identical, as the primary weapon can only be a shotgun.
A.T.H.E.N.A. (Augmented Telecom Hub Extension Network Agent) is an artificial intelligence housed within the Sugar Grove facility in Appalachia. It appears .
Calvert Mansion is a large Victorian mansion located in Point Lookout in 2277. It is inhabited by Desmond Lockheart, a 200-year-old ghoul from before the Great War.
Chadwell was a member of the West Tek research center's cleaning staff who fell into a tank of FEV before the Great War.

The (Russian: Пулемёт Дегтярёвa; Degtyaryova Pulemyot; English: Degtyaryov's Machinegun) was a Soviet light machine gun designed by Vasily Degtyaryov in 1927. Though not very widely used by the Soviet Army, many DP-28 machine guns were used and produced by other countries such as Finland and the People's Republic of China (where it was designated Type-53) who then sold many units to the neighboring North Korea and North Vietnam. The DP-28 fired the 7.62x54mmR cartridge at a rate of fire around 550 rounds per minute from a 47-round pan magazine placed on top of the gun. It was commonly nicknamed the "record player" by the Red Army due to its pan magazine and rotating cover.

Wise Charles the Forewarned, formerly known as Brother Charles, is a member of the Enlightened who lives at the Lantern. He was first a mentioned-only character in Fallout 76, before appearing fully in the Night of the Moth update. Charles was a member of the pre-War Cult of the Mothman at Point Pleasant in Appalachia, and his vision mobilized them to take shelter before the War. Each Mothman Equinox, he travels to his former home town to participate in summoning the Wise Mothman.
The deathclaw guard is an intelligent deathclaw in 2241 that was cut from Fallout 2.

Dogs are creatures found across the post-War United States. Many have remained domesticated pets, but many more have turned feral and hunt the wasteland in packs. The dogs that survived the War are a larger and tougher breed, now almost wolf-sized. Even so, just as they have in ages past, many dogs have remained faithful and beloved companions.

The Daihatsu-class landing craft (Japanese: 大発 Daihatsu; short for 大型発動機艇 Ōgata hatsudō-ki-tei; English: Large Motorized Boat) was a Japanese type of landing craft used by special forces of the Imperial Japanese Navy during World War II. It was similar to the LCVP with a bow ramp that allowed soldiers to disembark once the vessel is beached.

Fawkes is a super mutant residing in a cell within Vault 87 in the Capital Wasteland in 2277, imprisoned there by his brethren for his peaceful nature and interest in learning history instead of killing humans. He is a possible companion of the Lone Wanderer.
Stealth technology is the use of advanced materials and design to drastically reduce the radar signature of a vehicle.
Fenris is one of the Mother's brood of hairy deathclaws in 2197. He was named by Beastlords.
Friedrich (GM-05) is a Mister Gutsy serving as a vendor at the Whitespring Resort in Appalachia.
Gargantua is a leader of a large group of raiders who opposed the Brotherhood of Steel in 2197.

A coaxial machine gun is a machine gun fitted to a coaxial mount as a secondary weapon beside a vehicle's main weapon. This allows the machine gun to be aimed by use of the main gun control. It is used to engage infantry or other "soft" targets when the main gun's potential collateral damage would be excessive, or to conserve its ammunition.
Gideon is one of the four psykers, along with Moore, Wiggum, and Lucy, kept in the Master's Lair beneath the Cathedral.
Hank is a 120 year old pleasant ghoul, the Reservation’s leading vendor of firearm sales.

Horatio is a very large ghoul from the Reservation, who almost resembles a super mutant. One could surmise that in his "smooth skin" days, he could have been an offensive lineman for pro football or a professional wrestler. Either way, his size carried over to his current ghoul form.
Cooldown is a period where an ability or use of a weapon is not available or its capabilities are reduced. Cooldown takes various forms depending on its use, but in general is a time limit.
John Bear is an arena fighter in the Pitt in 2277 alongside his brother Grudd Bear.

K-9 is an advanced model of cyberdog created sometime around 2241 by Dr. Schreber at Camp Navarro for deployment under Dick Richardson's division of the Enclave. However, the doctor perfected his creation too well, and created a fully sentient, talking cyberdog with abilities that extend beyond the normal, and a burning hatred of its creator. He appears as a potential companion of the Chosen One .
Linda-Lee is a giant hermit crab residing at Fisherman's Rest in Appalachia along with her owner Captain Raymond Clark in 2105. She appears .
The Copperhead Barrel is a weapon attachment featured in Battlefield Play4Free. It increases the range of weapons and the velocity of ammunition but allows for less control.

Lucy Grandchester was the young heiress of the Grandchester family before the Great War and the focus of the Grandchester Mystery Mansion exhibit near the site of Nuka-World, which her ghost haunts to the present day. She appears .

Mama Murphy is a chem-addicted fortune teller who allegedly wields a precognitive power called "the Sight". Formerly residing in the town of Quincy in the Commonwealth until it was attacked by the Gunners during the Quincy Massacre, Murphy escaped along with Preston Garvey and her fellow settlers and eventually sheltered in the Museum of Freedom within Concord. She appears .

A is a weapon consisting of a bow mounted onto a stock that shoots projectiles named bolts or quarrels at parabolic arcs. Their first major usage originates in China around 600 BCE. Although they see very little use in modern militaries, crossbows are still used for hunting and recreational target shooting. Modern crossbows can be mounted onto rifle receivers, allowing accessories such as optical sights to be easily added.

The Mother of the Fog, identified in-game as a ghostly figure, is a mythical figure worshipped by the Children of Atom sect residing on the Island. Most claim her to be a benevolent guardian spirit that led the Children to safety at the Nucleus, while some among them believe her to be a simple hermit who helped the Children in their time of need.

Ragnarök is a malevolent spirit from Grognak the Barbarian's universe, capable of possessing the mind and body of a person. In the issue it appears in, it has possessed Grognak, starting the Grog-Na-Rök, and laying waste to most of the Unstoppables, with the Mistress of Mystery the last woman standing.

This counteracts the potential of the muzzle to flip to either side. As a consequence, the visible flash of the weapon may be even greater than without a compensator. __TOC__

The Robobrain is a next-generation brain bot-type cyborg appearing throughout the Fallout series. Developed by General Atomics International and the US Army with indirect support from RobCo Industries, the Robobrain was designed from the ground up as a multirole platform for use by military and civilian clients. They are more flexible and powerful than robots due to the fact that their central control and processing unit is an actual brain, rather than an artificial facsimile. Coupled with a robust, all-terrain tracked chassis and powerful armaments, the Robobrain was on the forefront of a new revolution in combat robotics.

Rock Teeth is a raider tortured into allying with Judge Zeller's army. Resilient to traditional methods of torture, even the removal of teeth, it took the threat of losing his eyes and hands to get him to join.
Samuel is a feral glowing one in 2277, found behind Takoma Industrial.

Decoy is a gadget featured in Battlefield Hardline. The gadget creates false targets on the minimap as well as gun fire sounds to confuse hostiles. It can therefor be used as an effective tool to ambush enemies or draw them away from objectives.
{{Quotation|{{tooltip|I'm the muscle, babe. Just don't piss me off, all right?|{threatening} }}}} Simone is the bodyguard of Wolfgang in the Commonwealth in 2287.

{{Quotation|{{tooltip|I'm Slag, and we are the Forged. And you, stranger - you're somebody with some guts. I like that.|{Impressed} }}|sound=Fo4 RaiderM2 00133C22_1.ogg}} Slag is the leader of the Forged, a fanatical gang of fire-worshiping raiders established in the Saugus Ironworks in 2287.
Stripe is a miniature deathclaw found in the year 2281 at the Big MT in the Fallout: New Vegas add-on Old World Blues.

Coastal artillery refers to anti-ship artillery or fixed gun batteries in coastal fortifications. Ranging from the Middle Ages until World War II, coastal artillery was extremely important in naval battles. The advent of 20th-century technologies, especially military aviation, naval aviation, jet aircraft, and guided missiles, reduced the primacy of cannon, battleships, and coastal artillery. In countries where coastal artillery has not been disbanded, these forces have acquired amphibious capabilities. In littoral warfare, mobile coastal artillery armed with surface-to-surface missiles still can be used to deny the use of sea lanes. It was long held as a rule of thumb that one shore-based gun equaled three naval guns of the same caliber, due to the steadiness of the coastal gun which allowed for significantly higher accuracy than their sea-mounted counterparts. Land-based guns also benefited in most cases from the additional protection of walls or earth mounds.
